title: Finding 3-Digit Even Numbers
goal: List every distinct three-digit even number constructible from the digit occurrences.
strategy: Enumerate numeric positions in ascending order. The hundreds digit cannot be zero, the units digit must be even, and repeated digits consume separate occurrences.
